card.name: Sensitivity or intolerance followed by to
card.fires_on: The word 'intolerance' or the word 'to' right after 'sensitive' or 'intolerance', where a drug or drug class the patient reacts badly to comes next.

modes.label: to after sensitive/intolerance
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'sensitive' or 'intolerance', just before the named drug or class.
modes.example: potentially fatal bronchospasm; and/or intolerance<< to>> aspirin and other NSAIDs. Because

modes.label: the word intolerance
modes.description: The noun or word 'intolerance' after 'exhibited' or 'and/or', before 'to' and a drug.
modes.example: by nasal polyps; severe, potentially fatal bronchospasm; and/or<< intolerance>> to aspirin and other NSAIDs.
